artworks.title: Possibly Margaret Robins
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl from the waist up, slightly turned to her left, with a calm expression. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, dark eyes, and dark brown curly hair. She is wearing a pink gown with lace-trimmed sleeves, a ruffled neckline, and a string of pearls around her neck. She is holding a small bird in her right hand. The background is dark and oval-shaped, and the portrait is enclosed in a dark circular border.

artworks.title: Penn's Treaty with the Indians
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: Eight pale-skinned men and thirteen brown-skinned, indigenous Lenape men, women, and a baby gather on a grassy field close to us in this horizontal painting. The white men are cleanshaven and have puffy gray, shoulder-length hair. Most wear black tricorn hats, and they all wear coats, vests, and pants in shades of tan, gray, red, brown, and white. An unfurled scroll in the middle of this group reaches from shoulder to calf, and most of the word “Pennsylvania” is legible there. Two bareheaded men kneel in front of the Lenape, holding a bolt of red cloth. The Lenape men wear black, red, and white feathered headdresses and gold earrings. Some are bare-chested and others wear furs or other garments in black or white. Three men are seated and look at the group of white men beyond the bolt of cloth. Others stand and look on, as two women and a baby sit in a trio to our left, under a tree. The women wear beaded headdresses and wear white or blue. One of the seated Lanape men holds a long, white clay pipe that spouts smoke from the short bowl. A bow and a quiver with arrows lies on the ground nearby. All the people are painted simply with large eyes, rounded lips, and oversized noses. To our right of the whole group, a pale-skinned man sits on a wooden chest with one foot resting on another chest. A second man there leans on another box or piece of furniture, and both look to our left. The grass slopes gently down to an ivory-white body of water in the distance. White and Lenape men meet near the shoreline. A boat carries seven people between us and a long white, two-storied building on the far shore. The sky above is pale pink along the horizon with wispy white clouds kicking up under an ice-blue band of sky along the top edge of the canvas. Closer to us, the grassy plateau ends with a shallow, rocky ledge. Text painted in a gold-brown field below the scene reads, “PENNS TREATY with the INDIANS, made 1681 with out an Oath, and never broken. The foundation of Religious and Civil LIBERTY, in the U.S. of AMERICA.” The surface of the canvas is cracked in some areas and is especially noticeable in the sky.

artworks.title: The Grave of William Penn
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a pastoral setting with a large white-and-gray house on a hill to the left. Distant people stand in front of the house, along with a horse-drawn wagon. In the bottom right corner, two people sit in the grass under a tree, one dressed in red holding a tall crook and the other wearing a black garment and a yellow hat and petting a large brown-and-white dog. There is a basket on the ground between them, and next to them is a large herd of cows and sheep, all resting on the grass. The landscape includes trees with green leaves and yellow hills in the distance. The sky above is in pastel shades of pink and blue, with fluffy clouds. In the bottom left, a patch of yellow ground has several lines of text written over it.

artworks.title: The Landing of Columbus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting features a scene showing men in a boat landing on a shore. The horizon is low, with larger sailing ships seen in the distance on the right, floating on the dark green water. The central boat has around eight men in it, all with tan skin and dark hair, dressed in bright garments in shades of red, blue, and gold. Many of them wear plumed helmets and have jewelry or badges adorning them. The boat is heading towards land on the left, and one man stands at the front of the boat, holding a white flag. The land on the left is green, with tall palm trees and a rocky gray mountain. People with dark skin can be seen in on the land in the distance, some climbing the mountain and others standing beneath trees. The sky is a gradient from pinkish-orange near the horizon to light blue at the top of the painting, with a few faint gray clouds.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Child
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: A pale-skinned child wearing a short-sleeved red dress and a white bonnet stands before a shadowy green forest under dark clouds in this vertical portrait painting. The child’s over-large head is out of scale with the rest of her body. She looks toward us with brown eyes in her wide, round-jawed face. She has a broad nose, and her pale lips are set in a line. Her lace bonnet lines her black hair like frothy seafoam and is tied with spring-green bows at the top and under her right ear, to our left. The low neckline of her crimson dress is lined with a wide white ruffle. Red fabric covers her hands, which are gathered in front of her waist. Gray clouds sweep over the hazy green forest in the background. A gnarled tree grows up the left side of the painting, framing the girl.

artworks.title: Peaceable Kingdom
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: Three small children with pale pink skin sit and stand among a group of animals to our right as a group of eight indigenous people with light brown skin gather with eight white-skinned men near a riverbank in the distance to our left in this horizontal painting. The children and animals take up the right two-thirds of the composition. They gather on a flat-topped spit of land, which is covered in grass. All three children have blond hair and rounded features. Two sit on the ground at the bottom center of the painting. The largest animal is a caramel-brown bull, which stands next to a pale golden lion. The other animals are smaller in scale, and include a tiger, wolf, sheep, goats, cows, bears, and a jaguar, all sitting or standing at rest around the bull and lion. At the top center of the group of animals, one child stands over the lion’s back and has one arm around the tiger’s shoulders, and another child at the lower center touches the jaguar’s nose. A tree with olive-green, rust-red, and harvest-yellow leaves grows up the right edge of the canvas, in front of a tall, forest-green bush. On another spit of flat-topped, elevated grassy land to our left, six of the indigenous people stand in a row, wearing feathered headdresses. Two more kneel in front, creating a U-shape. The two in front wear loin cloths, and all eight wear gold earrings and necklaces. They face a gathering of eight men wearing tricorn hats, long coats, waistcoats, knee-length britches, and stockings in shades of gray, blue, white, brown, and orange. One of these men hold up a roll of cloth lifted out of a chest. Trees with spindly trunks and golden yellow canopies reach into the top corner of the painting along the left edge. The river extends into the distance beyond this group, with pale, sage-green hills carpeted in trees. Puffy white clouds float across a sky that deepens from pale shell pink along the horizon to light blue along the top. The features of the animals and children are painted simply and appear rather flat, giving them an almost cartoonish look.

artworks.title: John Harrisson
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting depicts a person from the waist up with a fair complexion, sideburns, dark combed-up hair, and a neutral facial expression. The individual's left hand is resting on the front of a brightly adorned military jacket. The jacket features red and gold decorations, gold shoulder epaulettes, a high collar, gold buttons, a white cravat, a decorative sash across the chest and waist, a sheathed sword attached to the waist, and an intricate gold belt. The background is a plain, muted gray.

artworks.title: Mrs. John Harrisson and Daughter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated with an infant on her lap. The woman is facing slightly to the left with her head turned towards the viewer. She has a calm expression with large eyes, thin lips, and dark hair under a lace-trimmed cap. She wears a high-collared dress with buttons and a shawl around her shoulders. The infant gazes directly at the viewer, wearing a bonnet with light blue ribbons and a white dress with a gold necklace. The woman's hand rests on the child, with a gold ring on her finger. The background is a dark, textured tone with a decorative chair featuring green, leaf-like designs.

artworks.title: The Burnish Sisters
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows two young girls standing together. The girl on the left is seated and holding a collection of colorful flowers in her lap. The girl on the right stands holding a toy lamb on wheels. Both girls have curly hair and wear dresses with unique details. The seated girl has a bow in her hair, wears a coral pink dress, and accessorizes with jewelry. The standing girl's dress is yellow with black polka dots and red ribbon accents. Both girls have soft facial features and blush on their cheeks. A woven basket full of flowers is placed between them on the ground. The background is simple and dark.

artworks.title: Sisters in Red
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows two children, a girl and a boy, depicted from head to toe. The girl is standing to the right, slightly turned towards the boy. She has dark hair tied back with a pink ribbon, and her facial features are serious with a fair complexion. The boy also has a fair complexion and short light-colored hair. They are both wearing matching red dresses with white lace collars and cuffs, and white pantalettes underneath. The boy holds a yellow ceramic jug decorated with a floral pattern, while the girl holds an open book in her hands. Around the girl's neck hangs a long chain with a circular pendant. The background features a dark, wooded area with bare trees, and in the distance, there is the silhouette of a house with smoke coming from the chimney, set against a pink and blue sky.

artworks.title: Basket of Fruit with Parrot
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting features an arrangement of fruit in a basket with a green parrot perched on a branch. The yellow woven basket contains an assortment of fruit, including a prominent orange pear, green and red grapes, purple plums, a pink peach, and small pink berries, all in front of a large green gourd. Some green leaves and brown branches also extend upwards out of the basket. The parrot is situated on a branch that extends upward from the left side of the basket of fruit. The bird is mostly light green but has vibrant, reddish-orange feathers on its tail and the ends of its wings. Its head is turned to the left, away from the basket, and its hooked beak is open.

artworks.title: The Sportsman's Dream
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Joshua Lamb
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image displays a child standing and facing forward. The child has a round face with rosy cheeks, wide blue eyes, and a small closed mouth. The child's hair is light and short. They are wearing a yellow dress with ruffled off-the-shoulder sleeves and holding a blue ribbon attached to a small dog with a beige and brown coat on a green cushion. The background shows greenery, trees, a small house, water with sailboats, and a village in the distance.

artworks.title: Baby in Wicker Basket
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a baby lying in a wicker cradle. The baby has a round face, light skin, large eyes, sparse light hair, and is wearing a blue dress. The baby is holding a small object in its left hand and is wearing red fabric on its feet. The cradle has a white pillow behind the baby's head and dark brown fabric underneath. The background has a dark area and a patterned floor with floral designs in shades of red and pink.

artworks.title: J. M. Stolle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young person standing and slightly turned to their right. They have light blonde, shoulder-length hair and a fair complexion. The person is dressed in a red overcoat with white accents and a white cravat, paired with black shoes. The individual is holding a scroll in their left hand and touching a small dog standing on its hind legs with their right hand. The background includes an archway or stone wall with plants growing on it, along with trees and a sunset or sunrise over mountains.

artworks.title: The Cat
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of a large cat's head amidst birds in a forest setting. The cat's head emerges from tall grass, and the rest of its body is not visible. Its fur is a mix of brown and black with a cream area around its nose and cheeks, and it has long white whiskers. Its ears are pricked up, and its yellow eyes are looking upwards. In the cat's mouth is a bird with blue and green feathers, a black head, and a long black beak. To the left and right of the cat are two thin trees with birds in them; on the left is a bright red bird, and on the right is a bird with teal, green, and black feathers. The trees depicted have sparse branches with a few green leaves at the top. The sky behind the cat and trees is light blue.

artworks.title: Captain Elisha Denison
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a man seated at a table. He is positioned with his body turned slightly to the right and his head facing forward towards the viewer. The man has a fair complexion, with light facial features, including light-colored eyes and a calm expression. His hair is brown and combed back, with slight waves on the side. He is wearing a formal dark jacket with large decorative buttons, a cream-colored waistcoat, and an elaborate white cravat with ruffled edges at the neck and cuffs. In his hand, he holds a quill, poised over a sheet of paper on the table. Beside the paper, there is an inkwell and another small cylindrical container. The background features a window view of a landscape, including a tree, a body of water, and a cloudy sky, with a red curtain draped across the top. A building is partially visible on the left side of the window.

artworks.title: Mrs. Elizabeth Noyes Denison
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a woman sitting in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to her left. She has delicate facial features, smooth complexion, arched eyebrows, and an expression that might suggest attentiveness. Her brunette hair is styled with curls on the sides and a hairpiece topped with a lace headdress. She wears a high-necked gown with long sleeves featuring lace detailing at the cuffs and a voluminous, dark brown skirt, along with a white shawl or fichu draped around her shoulders. Her left hand is visible resting on her lap, while the other hand is unseen. A bracelet or band is visible on her right wrist. The background features a red curtain with a white trim drawn to the side, revealing a scenic view of a bridged body of water and surrounding greenery, with a partly cloudy sky above.

artworks.title: Miss Denison of Stonington, Connecticut (possibly Matilda Denison)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Horizon of the New World
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Innocence
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a seated infant facing forward. The child has a round face with blue eyes and light hair. They wear a white dress with lace and embroidery, painted floral designs in pink and green, and hold a round object tied with a blue ribbon on their lap. Blue shoes are placed next to their bare feet. The background is a plain brown color.

artworks.title: Susanna Truax
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: A pale-skinned girl wearing a striped dress and holding up a spoon and a rose looks out at us in this vertical portrait painting. Her body faces us, and her head turns lightly to the left. She has a wide, square face with large, dark eyes, flushed cheeks, and her dark pink lips curve in a slight smile. Her dark brown hair is parted in the middle and gathered at the nape of her neck. A thick curl drapes over one shoulder. Her dress has a rounded, lace-edged neckline, a tightly fitting bodice, long, and loose sleeves gathered at the elbows over a transparent white under-shirt. The ankle-length skirt flares from the waist, and the dress is vertically striped in apple red, forest and laurel green, and white. She wears a dangling pearl earring in the ear we can see, and her gold necklace has a horizontal, oval, gold plaque at the center. Her shoes have low heels and are striped red and white to either side of a gray band that runs back from the pointed toes along the shank of the shoe. The girl holds a spoon in her raised right hand, to our left, with what appears to be a sugar cube on it. Her other elbow is bent so she holds a pink rose at her waist with that hand. To the left, a small round wooden table holds a white teapot with a black handle and lid finial, a teacup and saucer, and a dish of what appears to be sugar cubes or sweets. The wall behind the young woman is dark pine green, and the floor is tan. A window over one shoulder, in the upper right quadrant of the painting, shows a pink, white, and blue sunset sky over a low band of dark green trees. Text painted in red at the upper left reads, “Susanna Truax, Gebooren den 8 1726, Geschilderd Maart, 173.” The final number looks like it could be a 0 or a 9.

artworks.title: Muster Day
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: Approximately two dozen people gather around a man standing with his mouth wide open and holding up two objects in a scarlet-red structure on a horse-drawn cart in this horizontal painting. The people appear to all have pale skin and most are men. Near the center of the composition, the man in the cart wears a white robe over a black, high-collared garment and a tall charcoal-gray hat. A hatch on the red structure appears to be open, and he holds up what might be books or pamphlets. A ginger-brown horse stands behind him with its head bowed. In the crowd, the men wear black, brown, gray, dark blue, or olive-green clothing and hats. Two women are to the left. One wears a green gown with a pumpkin-orange shawl and a wide-brimmed bonnet. She faces away from us. She and two men talk near a stand where another man and woman sell food and drink. More people gather around a second stand or structure beyond this, and, in the lower left corner of the painting, a man with white hair and a hooked nose and chin sits by an open cart with a sign reading, “Bear O! Pi Aiggs.” A few men dance and others mill about to the right of the cart. Closer to us, one boy runs toward another as a soldier lies belly-down on the ground, holding a bayoneted rifle out toward a brown dog. The dog crouches with its mouth open. Beyond the dancers and onlookers, a field stretches back to wooded hills. In the field, more than a hundred people stand or march in lines. Lavender-tinged clouds pile up in the blue sky over the horizon, which comes about halfway up this composition.

artworks.title: Indian Tobacco Shop Sign [obverse, Indian facing left]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in profile, standing facing left. They are holding a bundle in one hand and wearing a colorful headdress with large feathers. The person has long black hair, a simple face, and wears a red garment with decorative patterns, brown leggings, and dark shoes. They also wear a bead necklace and carry a long object over their shoulder. The background is a light yellow color.
